text: {"name":"ble_ll_hci_cmd_allowed","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns whether a command ID, or the subcommand of command 0xFF, is allowed by the configured command filter; an absent filter allows all commands.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"command_id","a2":"subcommand_id","a3":"command_filter","v3":"command_id_count","v4":"subcommand_id_count","v9":"command_ids","v10":"command_ids_end","v5":"subcommand_ids","v6":"subcommand_ids_end"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"Number of command IDs in the filter"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Byte array of allowed command IDs"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Number of subcommand IDs for command 0xFF"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Byte array of allowed subcommand IDs"}]}
